name: background-ripple-effect
blurb: Grid of cells explodes in ripple waves on click.
description: Absolute-positioned grid background with clickable cells. On click, triggers staggered ripple animation based on distance from click point using CSS custom properties for colors.
use_when: Interactive background needing click feedback, suitable for hero sections with engagement.
avoid_when: Touch devices without hover, or backgrounds that must be passive/decorative.
a11y: Click handler on cells; no keyboard equivalent or focus ring visible on ripple trigger.
